scripts.db:migrate: npx dotenv-cli -e apps/api-golang/.env.local -- sh -c 'migrate -path apps/api-golang/internal/db/migrations -database "$DATABASE_URL" up'
scripts.db:schema: docker exec epsilon-postgres sh -c "pg_dump --schema-only --no-owner --no-privileges -U postgres epsilon | sed '/^\\restrict/d;/^\\unrestrict/d'" > apps/api-golang/internal/db/schema/schema.sql
scripts.db:sync: yarn db:migrate && yarn db:schema && yarn db:generate
scripts.db:reset: yarn db:down && yarn db:up && yarn db:sync
